items.headline:
HEDGE FUNDS PILE BACK INTO STOCKS

Hedge funds bought global equities for a second straight week, reversing a sharp risk reduction in late July, according to Goldman Sachs.

Gross trading activity rose at the fastest pace in seven weeks, with long buying outpacing short sales

HASSETT RULES OUT REPLACING FED’S COOK

White House economic adviser Kevin Hassett says he will not replace Fed Governor Lisa Cook if she is removed, calling the allegations against her a law-enforcement matter.

Hassett said he hopes Cook is innocent as she challenges President

items.headline:
Women Surpass Men in U.S. Payroll Jobs

Women now hold more U.S. payroll jobs than men, according to Business Insider.

This has occurred only twice before, briefly during the Great Recession and again just before COVID-19.

The shift highlights changing patterns in employment
